message.content:
### Building a New PC – Step‑by‑Step Guide Below is a practical, beginner‑friendly walkthrough. Feel free to skip sections you already know, but keep the safety and order in mind. | # | Task | Key Points | |---|------|------------| | 1 | **Plan & Budget** | • Decide purpose (gaming, workstation, general use).
• Set a budget (CPU, GPU, motherboard, RAM, storage, PSU, case, peripherals). | | 2 | **Gather Components** | • CPU, motherboard, RAM, GPU (if not integrated), storage (SSD/HDD), power supply unit (PSU), case, cooling (stock or aftermarket).
• Optional: Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth card, sound card, extra fans. | | 3 | **Prepare Workspace** | • Clean, flat surface.
• Anti‑static wrist strap or mat.
• Screwdrivers (Phillips #0, #1). | | 4 | **Install CPU** | 1. Open CPU socket latch.
2. Align CPU (gold triangle) with socket.
3. Gently place, lock latch. | | 5 | **Apply Thermal Paste & Install Cooler** | • If cooler has pre‑applied paste, skip.
• Otherwise, apply pea‑size amount on CPU.
• Mount cooler, secure screws. | | 6 | **Insert RAM** | • Open DIMM slots.
• Align notch, press until clicks. | | 7 | **Mount Motherboard in Case** | • Align standoffs with holes.
• Screw motherboard to standoffs. | | 8 | **Install Power Supply** | • Place PSU in case (usually bottom rear).
• Secure with screws. | | 9 | **Connect PSU to Motherboard** | • 24‑pin ATX + 8‑pin EPS (CPU). | |10 | **Install Storage** | • Mount SSD/HDD in drive bays or M.2 slot.
• Connect SATA data & power cables if using SATA drives. | |11 | **Install GPU** | • Insert into top PCI‑e x16 slot.
• Secure with screws.
• Connect 6‑/8‑pin PCI‑e power cables from PSU. | |12 | **Cable Management** | • Route cables neatly.
• Use zip ties or Velcro straps.
• Keep airflow unobstructed. | |13 | **Connect Front Panel & Peripherals** | • USB, audio, power button, reset button, LEDs.
• Refer to motherboard manual for pin layout. | |14 | **First Boot** | • Power on.
• Enter BIOS/UEFI (usually F2, Del, Esc).
• Check CPU, RAM, storage detection. | |15 | **Install Operating System** | • Create bootable USB (Windows, Linux).
• Boot from USB, install OS. | |16 | **Install Drivers & Updates** | • Motherboard chipset, GPU, Wi‑Fi, audio.
• Windows Update or Linux kernel updates. | |17 | **Test & Benchmark** | • Run stress tests (Prime95, 3DMark).
• Monitor temperatures (HWMonitor, MSI Afterburner). | |18 | **Final Adjustments** | • Add additional fans or RGB lighting.
• Ensure cable lengths are adequate. | --- #### Quick Tips - **Static Safety**: Ground yourself before touching components. - **Component Compatibility**: Verify CPU socket, motherboard chipset, RAM type, and PSU wattage. - **Cooling**: Stock coolers are fine for low‑end CPUs; consider aftermarket for overclocking. - **Cable Lengths**: Longer cables give more flexibility; shorter ones reduce clutter. - **BIOS Settings**: Enable XMP for RAM, set boot priority, disable unused ports. #### Common Pitfalls | Issue | Fix | |-------|-----| | CPU not seated properly | Re‑open socket, align correctly, lock latch. | | GPU not recognized | Ensure PCI‑e slot is fully inserted, power cables connected. | | Overheating | Check fan orientation, improve airflow, reapply thermal paste. | | No boot after OS install | Verify boot order, check SATA cables, ensure OS is on correct drive. | --- ### Resources - **PCPartPicker** – Build planner & compatibility checker. - **YouTube Channels** – Linus Tech Tips, JayzTwoCents, Paul's Hardware. - **Manuals** – Keep motherboard, PSU, and case manuals handy. - **Forums** – r/buildapc on Reddit for troubleshooting. Happy building! If you hit a snag, let me know which step and I’ll help troubleshoot.
